request-boolean.source:
<?php
use Magix\Cache\Attribute\Cache;
use Magix\Cache\Attribute\CacheTtl;
use Magix\Cache\Cacheable;
use Magix\Cache\Cached;
use Magix\Cache\Metadata\Visibility;
class Sources {
    use Cacheable;
    #[Cache(ttl: 30, tags: ['common', 'a'])]
    public function short(): Cached { return $this->cached(fn () => Cached::of(1)); }
    #[Cache(ttl: 60, visibility: Visibility::Private, tags: ['common', 'b'])]
    public function long(): Cached { return $this->cached(fn () => Cached::of(2)); }
    #[Cache(ttl: 0, tags: ['common'])]
    public function zero(): Cached { return $this->cached(fn () => Cached::of(3)); }
    #[Cache]
    public function unlimited(): Cached { return $this->cached(fn () => Cached::of(4)); }
}
class Root {
    use Cacheable;
    public function __construct(private Sources $sources) {}
    #[Cache]
    public function run(bool $flag): Cached {
        return $this->cached(function () use ($flag) { return $flag ? $this->sources->short() : $this->sources->long(); });
    }
}

use Magix\Cache\Attribute\Cache;

use Magix\Cache\Cached;
use Magix\Cache\Metadata\Visibility;
class Sources {

<?php
use Magix\Cache\Attribute\Cache;
use Magix\Cache\Attribute\CacheTtl;
use Magix\Cache\Cacheable;
use Magix\Cache\Cached;
use Magix\Cache\Metadata\Visibility;
class Sources {
    use Cacheable;
    #[Cache(ttl: 30, tags: ['common', 'a'])]
    public function short(): Cached { return $this->cached(fn () => Cached::of(1)); }
    #[Cache(ttl: 60, visibility: Visibility::Private, tags: ['common', 'b'])]
    public function long(): Cached { return $this->cached(fn () => Cached::of(2)); }
    #[Cache(ttl: 0, tags: ['common'])]
    public function zero(): Cached { return $this->cached(fn () => Cached::of(3)); }
    #[Cache]
    public function unlimited(): Cached { return $this->cached(fn () => Cached::of(4)); }
}
class Root {
    use Cacheable;
    public function __construct(private Sources $sources) {}
    #[Cache]
    public function run(int $offset): Cached {
        return $this->cached(function () use ($offset) { return Cached::of("payload", new \Magix\Cache\Metadata\CacheMetadata(expiresAt: 1000.0 + $offset, tags: ["common"], visibility: Visibility::Private)); });
    }
}
